# Hardware volume rule fixtures for x20-volume-core.decide().
# Columns (whitespace separated):
#   case-name  chain  previous  volumes  saved  enabled  actions  members
# chain: the sinks from the default down to the hardware, comma separated
#   (chain[1] is the default; "-" = no default). Short names: spk = the
#   hardware speaker sink, jack = the headphone jack sink, bt = a Bluetooth
#   headset; x20-* are our sinks.
# previous: members remembered from the last run, comma separated; "first"
#   = first run (nothing remembered), "none" = an empty set.
# volumes: name=linear volume of every node present ("-" = none present).
# saved: name=volume saved by the rule ("-" = nothing saved).
# enabled: yes / no (x20.hardware_volume).
# actions: expected actions, ";" separated (save:N=V, set:N=V, forget:N),
#   "none" = nothing. members: expected members, comma separated, or "none".

# --- the default becomes one of ours
speakers-raise-hardware           x20-speakers,spk                         first                 x20-speakers=1,spk=0.166                          -                            yes  save:spk=0.166;set:spk=1                                                spk
speakers-hardware-already-full    x20-speakers,spk                         first                 x20-speakers=0.5,spk=1                            -                            yes  none                                                                    spk
speakers-own-volume-untouched     x20-speakers,spk                         first                 x20-speakers=0.3,spk=0.5                          -                            yes  save:spk=0.5;set:spk=1                                                  spk
surround-raises-both-stages       x20-speakers-surround,x20-speakers,spk   first                 x20-speakers-surround=0.4,x20-speakers=0.7,spk=0.5  -                          yes  save:x20-speakers=0.7;set:x20-speakers=1;save:spk=0.5;set:spk=1         x20-speakers,spk
headphones-raise-jack             x20-headphones,jack                      first                 x20-headphones=0.5,jack=0.4,spk=1                 -                            yes  save:jack=0.4;set:jack=1                                                jack
headphones-raise-bluetooth        x20-headphones,bt                        first                 x20-headphones=0.5,bt=0.6                         -                            yes  save:bt=0.6;set:bt=1                                                    bt

# --- moving between our sinks
surround-to-speakers-restores-x20-speakers  x20-speakers,spk           x20-speakers,spk      x20-speakers=1,spk=1                              x20-speakers=0.7,spk=0.5     yes  set:x20-speakers=0.7;forget:x20-speakers                                spk
speakers-to-surround-raises-x20-speakers    x20-speakers-surround,x20-speakers,spk  spk     x20-speakers-surround=0.5,x20-speakers=0.8,spk=1  spk=0.5                      yes  save:x20-speakers=0.8;set:x20-speakers=1                                x20-speakers,spk
headphones-unplugged-to-speakers  x20-speakers,spk                         jack                  x20-speakers=0.5,jack=1,spk=0.5                   jack=0.4                     yes  set:jack=0.4;forget:jack;save:spk=0.5;set:spk=1                         spk
speakers-to-headphones            x20-headphones,jack                      spk                   x20-headphones=0.5,jack=0.4,spk=1                 spk=0.5                      yes  set:spk=0.5;forget:spk;save:jack=0.4;set:jack=1                         jack
headset-changes-under-same-default  x20-headphones,bt                      jack                  x20-headphones=0.5,jack=1,bt=0.6                  jack=0.4                     yes  set:jack=0.4;forget:jack;save:bt=0.6;set:bt=1                           bt

# --- the default becomes a hardware sink
speakers-to-hardware-restores     spk                                      spk                   spk=1                                             spk=0.166                    yes  set:spk=0.166;forget:spk                                                none
surround-to-hardware-restores-all spk                                      x20-speakers,spk      x20-speakers=1,spk=1                              x20-speakers=0.7,spk=0.5     yes  set:spk=0.5;forget:spk;set:x20-speakers=0.7;forget:x20-speakers         none
hardware-nothing-saved            spk                                      first                 spk=0.5                                           -                            yes  none                                                                    none
hdmi-restores-speakers            hdmi                                     spk                   hdmi=0.8,spk=1                                    spk=0.5                      yes  set:spk=0.5;forget:spk                                                  none

# --- manual changes and repeated evaluations
user-lowered-hardware-sticks      x20-speakers,spk                         spk                   x20-speakers=1,spk=0.3                            spk=0.5                      yes  none                                                                    spk
user-lowered-unsaved-sticks       x20-speakers,spk                         spk                   x20-speakers=1,spk=0.3                            -                            yes  none                                                                    spk
same-chain-again                  x20-speakers,spk                         spk                   x20-speakers=1,spk=1                              spk=0.5                      yes  none                                                                    spk
first-run-keeps-older-saved       x20-speakers,spk                         first                 x20-speakers=1,spk=0.3                            spk=0.5                      yes  set:spk=1                                                               spk

# --- nodes not present (start-up order, a headset that went away)
hardware-not-present-yet          x20-speakers,spk                         first                 x20-speakers=1                                    -                            yes  none                                                                    none
hardware-appears                  x20-speakers,spk                         none                  x20-speakers=1,spk=0.5                            -                            yes  save:spk=0.5;set:spk=1                                                  spk
saved-node-absent-kept            x20-speakers,spk                         spk                   x20-speakers=1,spk=1                              bt=0.6,spk=0.5               yes  none                                                                    spk
headphones-without-headphones     x20-headphones                           first                 x20-headphones=0.5,spk=1                          -                            yes  none                                                                    none
no-default                        -                                        spk                   spk=1                                             spk=0.5                      yes  set:spk=0.5;forget:spk                                                  none

# --- x20.hardware_volume off
off-restores                      x20-speakers,spk                         spk                   x20-speakers=1,spk=1                              spk=0.5                      no   set:spk=0.5;forget:spk                                                  none
off-never-raises                  x20-speakers,spk                         first                 x20-speakers=1,spk=0.5                            -                            no   none                                                                    none
